properties.evidence: The pasted analysis counts 'schema flexibility — attach completely different property keys without breaking a strict schema' as a benefit. reflow2's store is a SCHEMA-VALIDATED graph store by design (schema-first is rule 1 of the project; defaults-do-not-assert, typed vocabulary, 29 node and 65 edge types with validated properties). A schemaless graph database as the store would let exactly the writes the validator exists to refuse; the option endangers the capability rather than serving it.
